newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's cyclone damage put at A$120 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's cyclone damage put at A$120 mln.

text.p: Australia's Deputy Prime Minister Tim Fischer said on Tuesday the damage bill to primary producers in north Queensland from cyclone Justin will exceed $120 million.

He was quoted by Australian Broadcasting Corp radio as saying it will take some time for primary producers in the region to bounce back. He was interviewed after a tour of sugar growing regions damaged by the cyclone.
Justin, the first cyclone to seriously hit Australia's sugarcane crop since the 1970s, landed as Australia was in the final months before the cane crush beginning in June.
At least 20 percent of Australia's once-expected 38-40 million tonnes of 1997/98 sugarcane had been seriously hit by Justin, the CANEGROWERS industry organisation said on Monday.
But the full extent of the damage will not be known for some time, it said.
The cyclone also is estimated to have destroyed one third of Queensland's banana crop for the next five months.
